description: Generated case vignettes paired with guideline reference paths, not independently sampled real patients
historical_notes: Earlier source history uses existing history_usage.json; official_test_clusters declaration alone is not counted as actual earlier input use.
No current fit/dev/old-test source overlaps are hidden: current_source_role is recorded per case and source.
No new review of every historical directory; no claim that no_recorded_input_use means never seen anywhere.
The total counts describe benchmark vignettes and paths; no independent real-patient sample count is provided.
theory_scope: Only finite root-to-leaf paths in released trees. Multiple newly generated vignettes for the same path do not create new independent guideline paths or patients.
medical_independent_sample_count: Not provided: released cases are generated vignettes. 1898 source clusters are provenance grouping, not a count of independent clinical patients.

execution_entrypoints.full_cache_example: ASTER_CR_ROOT=<new_run_root> ASTER_CR_GPUS=0,1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -m experiments.aster_cr.paths --model qwen --split test --shard 0 --shards 2
collector_prerequisites: Root frozen_methods.json is the new selected-method manifest; original collect only produces raw features, not new neural readouts.
